summary: Arterial kerb with no kerbside parking, shrubs behind and apartments close by.
reasons: Main road, almost no parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 14 m at the start, 23 m and 27 m elsewhere; overlooked by flats.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb sits against a verge with hedge; no clear bay beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with centre line and turning lane at the junction.
drivers.convention: One car stopped at the kerb in QLD, none in Esri; no marked parking lane and no signs.

sun_shade: Tree canopy over the eastern end; flats shade from the north.

best_section.where: Sir Fred Schonell Drive north kerb, outside the apartment car park
